_about: Assumptions behind the value estimate. Every figure here is an illustrative placeholder to replace with finance-approved unit costs and Service SA channel reports. costPerTransaction is the cost to government of one transaction in each channel (AUD). For each service, 'otherwise' is where an app transaction would most likely have happened without the app (shares add to 1), and otherChannelsPer30Days is how many of that service's transactions still happen outside the app in a typical 30 days. programmeCosts are what it costs to run the app beyond Azure: oneOffBuild is the build and launch cost, counted on buildDate; otherRunningPerMonth is the team, support and licences per month. They are used for net benefit and payback. attribution is the share of app transactions counted as genuinely moved from another channel (1 = all of them).
